purpose: Persistent registry for non-canonical token families, structural lenses, and blind analogical arcs.
rules: Lateral material is preserved and executable as evidence without modifying canonical F=244.
Pre-H analogical search may introduce new lateral tokens and relations before hypothesis formation.
Pre-H search is blind to case identity and future outcome.
Search results do not assign canonical weights and cannot decide H alone.
Post-H contrast cannot rewrite the already formulated H.
External API retrieval is a transport layer; the motor remains provider-neutral through SearchAdapter.
